verdict.rationale: DeepSeek's own API exposes the core model capabilities: thinking and non-thinking modes, multimodal vision, tool calls, JSON output, and streaming. That suggests broad overlap with what a chat UI offers. However, nothing in the evidence compares the API against the consumer UI or claims feature parity, so the 'everything' part of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: explicit API–UI parity documentation, API equivalents for UI features such as web search, file uploads and conversation history management, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Supports both non-thinking and thinking (default) modes
the new multimodal vision understanding model DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp is now available on the DeepSeek API platform
tool use is a documented first-class capability of the API
you can set the `stream` parameter to `true` to get stream response
